curated.tagline: Context compaction for agent harnesses: keep what still matters, tombstone the rest
curated.description: A retention filter for agent transcripts, not a summarizer. A decision model scores each span against the conversation's moving highlight; top spans stay verbatim, the middle band becomes one-line tombstones, and the full transcript stays on disk. An MCP restore server rehydrates any tombstone on demand. A heuristic scorer works offline with no keys.
highlights: Scores spans on relevance to the current topic and how load-bearing they are
Token-budget knapsack: keep verbatim, tombstone, or drop
context-restore MCP server rehydrates tombstoned spans
Stdlib-only Python; Claude Code adapter ready, Codex and OpenCode next
curated.architecture: Transcript → spans → highlight → score → budget knapsack → kept spans + tombstones → MCP restore
